stem: The ARR of Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription, was €240,000 in September 2026, but its revenue over the 12 months to September was €205,000. Both figures are computed correctly. Which explains the gap best?

options.text: MRR grew in the year, and ARR projects only the latest month
ARR includes the one-off setup fees, which revenue leaves out
ARR counts each Business Care Year fee twelve times over
Revenue leaves out the businesses on the €65 plan
